class: scratch roots leaked when a run is killed (SL-105 critique m1, accepted as O-011)
bounded_by: Who leaves one: a Mutants.ps1 run that did not reach its `finally` (the engine's case runner ends a case at 120 s, a tool call has its own limit, a person closes the window), a build server or test host that still holds a file of the copy, a copy that holds read-only files, a run still in progress, and a process id that has been handed to something else since. Not covered: a link inside a copy (a copy is made of plain files), a copy on another volume, an ACL that denies the sweep the delete.

fields.name: how the entry under the base is named: pid = fsa-sl105-mutant-<owner pid>-<8 hex digits> (what Mutants.ps1 makes), legacy = fsa-sl105-mutant-<8 hex digits> with no process id (the name the design's prose procedure gave its copies), other = a folder of another slice's, with the prefix fsa-sl102-mutants-
fields.owner: the process id in a pid name: dead = a PowerShell that has exited, self = the runner's own, liveOther = a running process that is not PowerShell (the id was handed on), none = no id in the name
fields.contents: what the killed run left inside: copied = some of the copied sources, built = bin and obj of the test build, results = a trx file, readOnly = a read-only file, empty = nothing, heldOpen = a file another process still has open without sharing
fields.expected: swept = gone after the sweep, kept = still there and reported kept, stuck = still there and reported stuck, ignored = still there and not reported at all (not a name the sweep looks at)
fields.produced_by: who or what leaves a root in this state
